items.headline: Dendy leads Bowling Green to first 2-0 MAC start since 2015 with 38-10 win over Sacramento State
items.description: — Austyn Dendy rushed for 86 yards and two touchdowns as Bowling Green scored 38 straight points to beat Sacramento State 38-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Leo Kemp's touchdown in waning seconds lifts Bowling Green to 24-20 win over Miami of Ohio
items.description: — Leo Kemp scored on a 2-yard run with 7 seconds remaining, lifting Bowling Green over Miami of Ohio 24-20 on Saturday in the Mid-American Conference opener for both teams.
